stories.title: File API エンドポイントとアプリスコープ評価

acceptance_criteria.description: GET / PUT / DELETE / list / mkdir / copy / move の各 API が仕様通りに動作する
acceptance_criteria.notes: Unit tests via MemBackend pass. E2E via Playwright against VM pending VM recovery.

acceptance_criteria.description: アプリスコープの share allowlist と path_deny に違反するアクセスは 403
acceptance_criteria.notes: Unit tests: missing token → 401, path traversal → 403, scope deny → 403. All pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: Range request でメディアのシークと部分読み取りが行える
acceptance_criteria.notes: Playwright E2E test passed against VM (206 returned with correct byte range). See manual verification: bytes=4-9 → 'EFGHIJ' confirmed before VM went offline.

stories.title: ビルトイン filebrowser (native アプリ)

acceptance_criteria.description: /ui/files でディレクトリ一覧 / ダウンロード / アップロード / 削除 / 名前変更ができる
acceptance_criteria.notes: Portal layout + files.tmpl render confirmed. Upload, delete, rename, mkdir UI all implemented with Playwright E2E tests. First E2E run: file list at /ui/files renders correctly against VM.

acceptance_criteria.description: アクセス権のない Share は表示されない
acceptance_criteria.notes: buildUserSharesFn filters by ACL: admin sees all shares, regular user only sees ACL-permitted. Unit logic verified. Playwright E2E tests the negative case (admin-only share not shown to regular user).

test_runs.notes: All packages pass. Pre-existing vet warning in engine/app/lifecycle_test.go unrelated to S0eedaa.

First test ([AC-S0eedaa-1-3] Range 206) PASSED. Later tests failed due to path conflict in test share setup (same /tmp path used by pre-existing e2e test share). Test files updated to use /var/tmp and shared beforeAll setup. Full run pending VM recovery.

known_issues.description: VM SSH unreachable during verification — likely sshd MaxStartups hit by background tasks from test session. Kura deployed and running as of 16:03 UTC. Full E2E re-run pending.
